name: Triprolidine Hydrochloride

fda.text: Liver warning This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take: more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours, which is the maximum daily amount with other drugs containing acetaminophen 3 or more alcoholic drinks daily while using this product Allergy alert Acetaminophen may cause severe skin…

summary: This medicine includes a warning for severe liver damage if you take more than 4,000 milligrams in a day, take it alongside other medicines with acetaminophen, or drink three or more alcoholic beverages every day [3]. The label also provides an allergy alert noting that acetaminophen can cause severe skin reactions [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated the drug's risk scores, rating the liver risk as low and the heart risk as medium [M].
